company.description:
Viosera Therapeutics is a predict and block drug resistance in cancer and bacteria. The company discovers synergies between approved drugs and develop combinations of drugs that suppress resistance. Antibiotic resistance makes it necessary to develop better treatments for deadly infections.

Viosera Therapeutics was founded in July 2016 and is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California.
